title: Consolidated Tactical H24N GribStream Backfill
objective: Acquire the compact exact-cycle H24N GribStream archive specified by the GPT-Pro tactical plan, without rebuilding a general NWP warehouse.

endpoint_policy.rate_limit_policy: few large requests, one worker, honor Retry-After, stop on 429/401 instead of hot-looping

location_policy.nbmoc_probe: HKO center plus marine_s_far plus marine_e_far

acceptance_criteria: T07-T12 split task folders are archived under tasks/superseded and only this consolidated GribStream fetch task remains active.
Legacy broad GribStream DB rows and raw payloads are purged from the active store.
The tactical schema exists under nwp_tactical with model_plan, variable_plan, location_stencil, acquisition_chunk, raw_response_object, forecast_wide, and validation_issue.
Smoke payloads use /runs timesList and exact lead windows; they never use broad forecastedFrom/forecastedUntil ranges.
A small authenticated smoke proves the request shape with no more than three GribStream data calls.
All future backfill work records chunks, request hashes, raw object hashes, status, errors, and row counts before promotion into feature views.

latest_progress.reason_not_completed: Full tactical backfill ran API-clean, but data-quality flags remain unresolved: ifsenfo recent chunks missing member 0, fourcastnetgfs tail empty, and nbmoc empty.

deep_sanity_audit.modeling_gate: filter source_response_object_id to raw_response_object.object_uri LIKE '%full_tactical_backfill_ok_tmax%' and enforce H24N leakage cutoff
